ITEM 1 | Sliced meat pieces, pinkish-brown interior with grayish-brown seared outer edges, moist surface with slight sheen, cut into strips about 5-6 cm long and 1.5-2 cm thick, several pieces lying across the lower right of the plate | 130
ITEM 2 | Roasted potato-like chunks, golden-brown exterior with crisp browned edges and paler yellow interior, irregular cubed or wedge shapes about 3-4 cm across, one large piece upper center and smaller pieces lower right and right | 110
ITEM 3 | Cooked green leafy vegetable, dark green wilted leaves with slight glossy sheen, clustered in center and extending down-right, leaves about 5-8 cm long, bunched and folded | 45
ITEM 4 | Long narrow green leaf, dark green, slightly wilted, lying diagonally at bottom center, about 9 cm long and 2.5 cm wide | 12
ITEM 5 | Orange-yellow cooked pieces, soft roasted texture with browning at edges, small cubes about 2 cm across, near top center and right of potatoes | 25
ITEM 6 | Meat piece, pinkish-grey and browned, flattened irregular shape with frayed edge, about 6 cm by 3 cm, upper left of plate beside greens | 40
